set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ENABLE_APIDOC OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBEDTLS_BUILD_EVEREST_THIRDPARTY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBEDTLS_BUILD_P256M_THIRDPARTY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_STATIC_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_SHARED_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MBEDTLS_FATAL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(mbedtls)
if(TARGET MbedTLS::MbedTLS)
else()
  add_library(MbedTLS::MbedTLS ALIAS mbedtls)
endif()
if(TARGET MbedTLS::MbedX509)
else()
  add_library(MbedTLS::MbedX509 ALIAS mbedx509)
endif()
if(TARGET MbedTLS::MbedCrypto)
else()
  add_library(MbedTLS::MbedCrypto ALIAS mbedcrypto)
endif()
set_property(TARGET mbedtls PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty")
set_property(TARGET mbedx509 PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty")
set_property(TARGET mbedcrypto PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty")
if(TARGET everest)
  set_property(TARGET everest PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty")
endif()
if(TARGET p256m)
  set_property(TARGET p256m PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty")
endif()
if(TARGET lib)
  set_property(TARGET lib PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty/internal")
endif()
if(TARGET apidoc)
  set_property(TARGET apidoc PROPERTY FOLDER "thirdparty/internal")
endif()
set(NO_EXAMPLES ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(NO_TESTS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(ETX_PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${BUILD_SHARED_LIBS})
set(ETX_PREVIOUS_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES ${CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES})
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_MBEDTLS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_GNUTLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES ON)

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ${ETX_PREVIOUS_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS} CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES ${ETX_PREVIOUS_SKIP_INSTALL_RULES})
